# All guitar and acoustic-guitar multi-effects — comparison

[Guitar](ALL-GUITAR.md) · [Bass](ALL-BASS.md) · [Vocal](ALL-VOCAL.md) · [Category](MULTI-EFFECTS.md) · [Repository](README.md)

All 266 recorded guitar/acoustic **multi-effects**, including effects-only HX Effects and Cerberus. Amp modeling, an expression pedal and floor operation are not inclusion requirements. Dedicated single-function pedals are in [SINGLE-GUITAR.md](SINGLE-GUITAR.md), outside these tables and active counts.

These are **comparisons of the recorded catalogue**, not exhaustive market coverage or fresh stock certification. Organized 2026-10-16 from the linked source records; their original technical/price dates, firmware, revision and access limits still apply. Every model remains partial. **? means unverified, not No.** Read the complete linked record for sources and conflicting evidence; this view does not silently resolve those conflicts.

K/F/B = independently adjustable rotary controls / footswitches / separate buttons; toe and power switches are additional unless explicitly stated. Body axes and mass qualifications are retained. Color does not prove touch; USB audio does not prove bus power; IRs, native NAM, converted NAM and proprietary captures differ.

| [BOSS ME-8](BOSS.md#me-8) | **Expression:** External EV-5 or FV-300L + PCS-33 supported; built-in/toe details pending. — Evidence: [Manual p34](https://cdn.roland.com/assets/media/pdf/ME-8_OM.pdf)<br>**Expression / control-effect restrictions:** **Slow Attack is CTL-only; Foot Volume is EXP-only**. Foot Volume preserves delay/reverb decay when lowering the pre-ambience signal. Feedbacker requires a stable single note; CTL press raises feedback and release mutes it, while EXP varies its level. Intelligent Ring Modulator recommends single notes and remains ring-modulated whenever selected. Pedal Wah supports CTL or continuous EXP. — Evidence: [Manual p13](https://cdn.roland.com/assets/media/pdf/ME-8_OM.pdf)<br>**Expression / Arm, Trip and Vibrato:** Arm Down 2 lowers two semitones; Down 3 one octave; Up 1 raises three semitones; Up 2 one octave. Trip 1 adds a voice up to two octaves above dry; Trip 2 adds one up to an octave below dry. CTL drives timed pitch movement; EXP follows pedal position. Vibrato: CTL gradually applies it while held; EXP varies depth and lifted position disables it. — Evidence: [Manual p14](https://cdn.roland.com/assets/media/pdf/ME-8_OM.pdf) | **K/F/B:** Separate rotary, footswitch and button counts pending visual/text reconciliation. — Evidence: Unresolved | **Display:** **Three-character seven-segment LED**; diagonal and touch unverified. — Evidence: [Manual p34](https://cdn.roland.com/assets/media/pdf/ME-8_OM.pdf) | **Dimensions / mass:** **422 W × 206 D × 55 H mm; 2.2 kg excluding adapter**. — Evidence: [Manual p34](https://cdn.roland.com/assets/media/pdf/ME-8_OM.pdf) |

CC69 snapshot changes received during preset loads are buffered until loading completes. **Shuffling controls (3.80 p.29):** Slices and SeqLen set chop count and sequence length; Shuffle/Pitch/Reverse/Repeat/Drift control random behavior. Smooth softens slice joins; Playback and Low/Hi Cut shape playback. Interval1/2 span −1 to +1 octave. Parameters can be controller-assigned. Press during playback reshuffles; double-press stops while retaining audio; hold during playback or stop deletes it. Shuffle0% with equal Slices/SeqLen isolates pitch/reverse processing. EXP1 defaults to Wah/Pitch Wham/Poly Wham control and bypass; EXP2 to Volume/Pan control when added through Signal Flow. FS1–6 toggle parameter endpoints; momentary/latching applies per switch, not per assignment. Swapping endpoints reverses control. Reserved global MIDI CCs cannot control parameters. Clear All removes snapshot and default pedal assignments too. Command Center stores assignments per preset, offers six automatic Instant commands, and sends MIDI commands through DIN OUT and USB together; command availability depends on source. Instant CC/Bank-Program/MMC/HX Looper values and CC Toggle/Ext Amp states follow snapshots. HXE-D pp.40–43 |

## Scope and provenance

Instrument views overlap and must not be summed. All 320 active models count once in `research-state.json`; the six explicitly excluded archives never enter these tables. Former/donated eligible devices remain without private receipt/order/payment details. Root brand records take precedence where consolidated; legacy sources remain for full evidence until a checked lossless merge. No GitHub workflow is used.
